_comment: Resource floors and ceilings the firmware must hold (docs/review-2026-09/). A change that breaks one raises it here deliberately, in the same commit, with the reason in the commit message. Runtime values are checked by tests/device/api_smoke.py (steady state) and tests/device/soak.py (the floor over a run); the static ones are read from `idf.py size` by tools/check_size.py and, later, by CI. Set on 2026-09-22 from the measurements after the configuration change P-M2.
